newsitem.title: USA: Northstar Health dismisses CEO Zaucha.
newsitem.headline: Northstar Health dismisses CEO Zaucha.

text.p: Northstar Health Services Inc said Tuesday it had removed Thomas Zaucha as chairman and chief executive officer of the company for alleged conflict of interest.
It said it named Robert Smallacombe as chief executive officer and Steve Brody as chairman. Both of them were directors.
The company said it had dismissed Zaucha for his "persistent and irreconcilable conflicts of interest between Zaucha's own interests and the interests of the shareholders of Northstar.

"These conflicts have been created because of Zaucha's position as the company's second largest creditor," it said. "(And because) his being the landlord in a number of real estate leases which the Audit and Standard Committee of the board of directors believe are excessive; and because he is one of the largest shareholders of Northstar common stock."
Northstar Health Services Inc is a regional provider of rehabilitation therapy, mobile diagnostics, subacute contracted care and related services at outpatient rehabilitation clinics.
